suits.do_text: Gain a [[scientist]]/[[telepath]] > [[ship]] > [[ally]]. If Duty Officer is not [[vulcan]], log Duty Officer. Log this card.

suits.text: Gain 1 [[research]] / [[military]] (whichever is higher).
suits.do_text: Gain [[scientist]]/[[anomaly]]/[[engineer]] > [[ally]], including from Junk. Dismiss Duty Officer.

suits.text: Log the top card of the Bot deck. Gain 1 [[research]] / [[military]] (whichever is lower). Send an [[away team]] to a neutral [[location]]. Promote this card to Duty Officer.
suits.do_text: If [[ship]] is in Bot Discard, put it on top of the Bot deck. Gain a [[res-focus]] > [[mil-focus]] > [[inf-focus]] > [[ship]] and dismiss Duty Officer.

suits.text: Gain a [[res-focus]] > [[scientist]]/[[telepath]] > [[ally]] and gain an [[incident]].
suits.do_text: Gain 1 [[research]]. Gain 1 [[influence]] / [[military]] (whichever is lower). If Duty Officer is [[vulcan]], discard the top 2 cards of the Bot deck; otherwise gain 1 [[glory]].

suits.text: Gain 1 [[research]]. Discard the top card of the Supplement deck.
suits.do_text: Gain 1 [[research]]. Gain 1 [[influence]]. Resolve the top card of the Supplement deck. Log this card.

suits.text: Discard the top 3 cards of the Bot deck. Gain 1 [[glory]].
suits.do_text: Gain 1 [[influence]]. Gain a [[res-skill]] > [[starfleet]] > [[cargo]]. Log Duty Officer.

special: If a card with [[path of surak]] would be logged when logging the top card of the Bot deck, ^discard it instead^.

bonus: BOOST: Gain 1 [[research]], 1 [[military]], and 1 [[research]]/[[military]].
BOOST: Before drawing the starting hand, find a [[person]], except in your Reserve deck, and promote them to Duty Officer.
BOOST: Gain 1 [[research]]/[[military]].
BOOST: After drawing the starting hand, find a [[person]] in your Draw deck.
